summary: More Ansible 14 community.general deprecations: the dconf fallback without gi.repository, installp (use ibm.power_aix.installp), layman, the loganalytics callback (use loganalytics_ingestion), Monit 5.18 or older, the pfexec become wrap_exe default changing to true, and the puppet timeout parameter.
questions: Will pfexec wrap_exe default to true?
Is the puppet timeout parameter deprecated?

answer_card.title: pfexec become: set wrap_exe
answer_card.answer_md: In community.general 14.0.0 the default of the `pfexec` become plugin option `wrap_exe` changes from `false` to `true`, because `pfexec` does not interpret shell constructs. Set `wrap_exe` explicitly (to `true` or `false`) to keep the behaviour you want and silence the deprecation warning.
